⚠️❄️ TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Bay St. George RCMP are issuing an advisory regarding road conditions across the Trans-Canada Highway in the Bay St. George and surrounding area, Heavy snow, snow cover, whiteout conditions and high winds are creating low visibility and hazardous road conditions. 

Police are requesting that motorists avoid all non-essential travel in this area at this time. If you must travel, please exercise extreme caution and drive according to road and weather conditions. 

#nltraffic #SnowMeansSlow
